name: Alana
detailed_description:
A couple’s world is torn apart by tragedy when a horrific accident takes their little girl’s life. As they attempt to come to terms with the loss, strange and unsettling things begin to happen, leading them to wonder whether it’s all just a result of their inability to accept what happened, or if something darker is lurking beneath the surface.

ALANA is a first-person psychological horror game that delves into the devastating consequences of an irreparable loss.

Duration: ALANA has an approximate playtime of 40 minutes to 1 hour.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Psychological Horror: A first-person psychological horror game that immerses you in a tense and unsettling atmosphere, where fear gradually builds through psychological horror and mystery.

  • Immersive Narrative: Dive into a deep and heartbreaking story, where the pain of loss forces the protagonists to confront the demons of their own mind.

  • Cartoon Aesthetic: A charming cartoon aesthetic that hides a darker, more unsettling atmosphere beneath its innocent surface.

  • Multiple Endings: The choices you make will influence the protagonists' destiny, leading the story in multiple directions.
